standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the reduction to a module of finite presentation by passing to an affine neighbourhood on the base and an open of the base change.

core_obligations: Reduce to the finite presentation case: the question is Zariski local, so go affine, embed the source into an affine space over the base, and reduce to the pushed forward module, which brings the morphism to finite presentation (proof lines 5740-5746).

Get a finitely presented module on a neighbourhood: by the local structure statement one may replace the base by the spectrum of the local ring of an elementary etale neighbourhood and the source by an open of the base change so that the module becomes of finite presentation (proof lines 5746-5750).

Conclude: apply the affine neighbourhood statement in the finite presentation case and then freeness of a projective module over a local ring to obtain an affine open on which the global sections are free (proof lines 5751-5755).
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction and embedding into an affine space (proof lines 5740-5746).
Reduction to a finitely presented module (proof lines 5746-5750).
Affine neighbourhood with projective sections, then freeness (proof lines 5751-5755).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a finite type module flat at a point of a locally finite type morphism, an affine elementary etale neighbourhood and an affine open of the base change on which the global sections of the restriction are free (statement lines 5727-5738, tag 05U7-adjacent). The proof reduces to the finite presentation case by embedding into an affine space and applying the local structure statement, then appeals to the finite presentation affine neighbourhood result and to freeness of projective modules over a local ring. The two reductions are the substance, so the claim is H2.
